item.title: Robots are getting neuromorphic skin that can feel pain
item.description: Human skin transmits sensory information as electrical pulses, or spikes, that encode signals related to pressure and pain. NRE-skin mimics this biological process by converting pressure inputs into spiking signals that can be processed in real time.Read Entire Article

item.title: While the world cools on EVs, Norway pushes to 96% electric sales
item.description: Last year, 95.5 percent of all newly registered vehicles in Norway were electric. While consumers in Europe and other markets are pivoting away from Tesla and toward hybrid vehicles, the Scandinavian country is staying firmly on course toward full EV adoption.Read Entire Article

item.title: HP plans EliteBook X laptops with AMD, Intel, and Qualcomm chips in one lineup
item.description: An internal HP roadmap for CES 2026 obtained by Windows Latest describes three near-identical models – EliteBook X G2a, G2i, and G2q – differing primarily in their use of Ryzen AI 400, Panther Lake Core Ultra, and Snapdragon X2-series processors, respectively.Read Entire Article

item.title: DarkSpectre quietly infected millions through seemingly legit browser extensions
item.description: The researchers initially discovered DarkSpectre while investigating ShadyPanda, a campaign based on popular Chrome and Edge extensions that infected over four million devices. Further analysis revealed that ShadyPanda was just one part of a three-pronged operation, each campaign following similar methods and malicious objectives.Read Entire Article

item.title: Instagram Reels went from TikTok clone to a $50 billion business for Meta
item.description: Meta's Reels began as a hasty response to TikTok's viral dominance. Five years later, the company's short-form video product has become one of its most significant revenue engines – expected to generate as much as Coca-Cola or Nike – and is now expanding to television screens.Read Entire Article

item.title: Qualcomm claims Snapdragon X2 Plus beats AMD and Intel in new benchmarks
item.description: The benchmarks are drawn from Geekbench 6.5 and UL's Procyon suite, run on Windows 11 laptops. Qualcomm claims the 10-core X2 Plus can deliver up to 3.1× higher multi-core CPU performance at the same power level as competing processors, while reaching up to 52 percent higher peak performance in those tests.Read Entire Article

item.title: BYD sold 2.2 million EVs worldwide in 2025, topping Tesla's 1.6 million
item.description: The reversal follows months of narrowing margins between the two companies. Throughout 2025, BYD repeatedly outsold Tesla in European markets, even as it faced import tariffs and ongoing US government restrictions that have kept the Shenzhen-based automaker out of the American consumer market.Read Entire Article
